name: Deleveraging Watch
description: Transparent concurrent-deterioration checks. Conditions are descriptive confirmations, not crash predictions or trading signals.

conditions.name: Margin leverage rolling over
conditions.description: FINRA margin-debt growth has turned negative year-over-year or decelerated sharply over three monthly observations.

conditions.name: Financial conditions tightening
conditions.description: The Chicago Fed NFCI is above its historical-average zero line or has tightened materially over roughly one quarter.

conditions.name: Financial risk unusually high
conditions.description: The NFCI risk subindex is at or above its strict-past 90th percentile.

conditions.name: Volatility stress unusually high
conditions.description: VIX is at or above its strict-past 90th percentile.

conditions.name: Market trend deteriorating
conditions.description: Shiller real total-return price is below its level six monthly observations earlier.

conditions.name: High/low breadth unusually weak
conditions.description: NYSE normalized high-low breadth is at or below its strict-past 10th percentile.

conditions.name: Volume breadth unusually weak
conditions.description: MRM Classic McClellan Volume Summation is at or below its strict-past 10th percentile.

conditions.name: S&P 500 50DMA participation unusually weak
conditions.description: S&P 500 percentage above 50DMA is at or below its strict-past 10th percentile.

conditions.name: S&P 500 200DMA participation unusually weak
conditions.description: S&P 500 percentage above 200DMA is at or below its strict-past 10th percentile.
